data.title: This video tutorial provides a step-by-step guide
data.content:
## Summary
This video tutorial provides a step-by-step guide on activating and configuring plugins within the Eliza OS agent framework. It specifically demonstrates how to enable Twitter posting, image generation using Together AI, and web search functionality via the Tavily API.

## Key Points
- Switching to the Eliza OS developer branch is recommended for the latest plugin features and bug fixes.
- Distinguishing between the Twitter Client (for automated interactions) and the Twitter Plugin (for posting tweets via conversation commands).
- Configuring API keys for third-party services like Together AI and Tavily in the .env and character files.
- Executing pnpm commands to clean, install, and build the framework to ensure plugins are correctly integrated.
- Using a local client interface to interact with the agent and verify that actions like web searching and tweeting are functioning.

## AI Concepts
AI Agent Framework, Autonomous Agents, Action/Tool Calling, Image Generation Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (Web Search), Agent Personality Configuration
